title: Open points of one knowledge pass with stable ids (artifacts/<product>/knowledge/open-points.json, or knowledge/modules/<m>/open-points.json), written only by scripts/knowledge.mjs through lib/registry.mjs (D-051). module-explorer accounts for every active id.

points.description: Keyed by the normalized open-point text (lowercase, whitespace collapsed, citations and the category tag removed).

status.description: A point that disappears is kept as gone; its id is never reused.

file.description: The file, relative to knowledge/, the point was last seen in.
